info.name: Medical365 ABDM M1 Phase 1A
info.description:
API security hardening & M1 foundation testing collection for Medical365 HMS.

Covers:
1. Auth Helpers (Optional token setup)
2. ABHA Status & RBAC Positive/Negative (401/403)
3. Patient Access & Multi-Tenant / ClinicPatient Isolation
4. ABHA OTP Generation (Cooldown & Rate Limits)
5. ABHA OTP Verification (Lockout, Expiry & Replay Protection)
6. HIP Bridge Admin & Role Resolution (/api/abdm/bridge/*)
7. ABDM Callbacks & Signature Verification

Notes:
- Endpoints marked [Requires ABDM Sandbox] call ABDM gateway/ABHA v3 endpoints and return HTTP 503 when ABDM_CLIENT_ID / ABDM_CLIENT_SECRET are not configured.
- Callback endpoints require ABDM_JWKS_URL or ABDM_CALLBACK_PUBLIC_KEY in production/staging (and by default in dev/test when ABDM_ALLOW_UNSIGNED_CALLBACKS=false); otherwise they return 503.
- Set ABDM_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY on the server before calling token encryption/link-token flows.

item.description: Use these helpers to acquire JWT tokens into environment variables if OTP is disabled/bypassed, or manually paste active tokens into the Postman environment.

item.name: Staff Password Login (POST /api/auth/login)

request.description: Existing endpoint: POST /api/auth/login (server/src/routes/auth.routes.js). Copies returned token if OTP is bypassed.

item.name: Patient Portal Login (POST /api/patient-auth/login)

request.description: Existing endpoint: POST /api/patient-auth/login (server/src/routes/patientAuth.routes.js). Stores patientToken on success.

[Positive - Requires ABDM Sandbox] Create ABHA Start OTP (POST /create/start)

request.description: REQUIRES VALID ABDM SANDBOX CREDENTIALS. Success 200: { success: true, configured: true, txnId, message: 'OTP sent to the Aadhaar-registered mobile number' }. Save createTxnId automatically. Error 503 when ABDM unconfigured; 400 on invalid Aadhaar; 409 if already linked; 429 on resend cooldown or rate limit.

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 (or 503 if Sandbox creds disabled / 429 cooldown)', function () {

exec: pm.test('Status is 200 (or 503 if unconfigured / 429 rate-limited)', function () {

item.name: 04 - ABHA OTP Verification, Lockout & Replay Protection
[Positive - Requires ABDM Sandbox] Create ABHA Verify OTP (POST /create/verify)

request.description: REQUIRES VALID ABDM SANDBOX CREDENTIALS & OTP. Expected 200: { success: true, message: 'ABHA created and linked to the patient', abha: { status: 'Verified', isVerified: true, maskedAbhaNumber, maskedAbhaAddress } }

item.name: [Positive - Requires ABDM Sandbox] Link Existing ABHA Verify OTP (POST /link/verify)

request.description: REQUIRES VALID ABDM SANDBOX CREDENTIALS & OTP. On 200, transaction becomes status=VERIFIED and subsequent replays of linkTxnId are rejected.

item.name: [Negative Validation] Verify Link - Missing txnId or otp (400)

exec: pm.test('Rejects missing txnId/otp with 400 (or 503 if unconfigured)', function () {

item.name: [Negative Security] Verify Link - Unknown/Forged txnId (403)

exec: pm.test('Rejects unbound txnId with 403 (or 503 if ABDM unconfigured)', function () {

item.name: [Negative Security] Cross-User Transaction Replay Blocked (403)

request.description: Use doctorToken on a linkTxnId started by receptionToken. Must fail 403 because AbdmTxn binds userId.

exec: pm.test('Another user cannot hijack txnId (403)', function () {

item.name: [Negative Security] Verify Link - Wrong OTP Lockout After 5 Attempts (Run 6x -> 429)

request.description: With an active linkTxnId (generated by receptionToken), send bad OTP repeatedly. After ABDM_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (5), AbdmTxn sets status=LOCKED for 15 min and returns HTTP 429.

exec: pm.test('Invalid OTP or Lockout status returned (400/429)', function () {

item.name: [Negative Security] Verify Link - Completed Transaction Replay Rejected (409 / 403)

request.description: Execute immediately after a successful /link/verify. Completed transaction is retained with status=VERIFIED so replay returns HTTP 409 (not 200).

exec: pm.test('Replayed verified txnId is rejected (409/403/404)', function () {

item.name: 06 - ABDM Callbacks & Signature Verification (Public Bridge Mount)
item.description: Mounted at app root before tenantResolver via ABDM_CALLBACK_PATH regex. REQUIRES ABDM_JWKS_URL or ABDM_CALLBACK_PUBLIC_KEY configured on server (unsigned callbacks are disabled by default and return 503 unless explicitly opted-in outside prod/staging).

exec: pm.test('Forged callback signature rejected (401 or 503 if unconfigured)', function () {

item.name: [Requires JWKS/PEM & Encryption Key] Link Token Callback (POST /v3/hip/token/on-generate-token)

request.description: REQUIRES configured ABDM_JWKS_URL/ABDM_CALLBACK_PUBLIC_KEY AND ABDM_TOKEN_ENCRYPTION_KEY (background processor encrypts linkToken in AbdmLinkToken). Expected sync HTTP 202: { status: 'ACK', requestId }.

item.name: [Requires JWKS/PEM & Sandbox] Care-Context Discover Callback (/user-initiated-linking/v3/patient/care-context/discover)

request.description: Expected sync 202 ACK. Inbox worker resolves Hospital User or ClinicPatient strictly inside hospital matching X-HIP-ID and replies via ABDM on-discover.

item.name: [Requires JWKS/PEM & Sandbox] Link Init Callback (/user-initiated-linking/v3/link/care-context/init)
[Requires JWKS/PEM & Sandbox] Link Confirm Callback (/user-initiated-linking/v3/link/care-context/confirm)

request.description: Triggers atomic onLinkConfirm OTP verification (5-attempt lock & VERIFIED status against replay).

item.name: [Requires JWKS/PEM] ABHA Deactivate Callback (POST /v3/abha/deactivate)

request.description: Deactivates ABHA linkage in both User and ClinicPatient models strictly within hospital matching X-HIP-ID.
